submission.justification: Simulated expected significance (statistical uncertainty only, 140 fb^-1) across working points: S3 (GBDT, all variables incl. jet substructure) peaks near 55-60% signal efficiency: 3.73 (30%), 3.90 (40%), 4.02 (50%), 4.07 (60%), 3.91 (70%). S2 (NN, kinematic only) reaches at most 3.42 (60%), and S1 (cut-based) gave 2.61 at 50%. S3 at 60% gives the highest expected significance of the three strategies. The 2025 summary is reproduced by the tool (S3 4.1, S2 3.4, S1 2.6 at 50%). CAVEAT: no project document reports data/MC validation-region agreement for any strategy, and the tool provides only statistical-uncertainty sensitivity. The 10% validation-region constraint is therefore unverified for S3 and must be checked before this recommendation is adopted. S3 relies on jet substructure, which is a plausible source of mismodelling. If S3 fails the validation check, the fallback is S2 at 60% (3.42 sigma), using kinematic variables only.
